title: Disappointment and stressful ownership issues
summary: This topic combines explicit disappointment and stressful ownership problems with several isolated undetermined remarks about blocked visibility, hidden displays, comparisons, and feature descriptions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe broad disappointment, recurring problems from early ownership, stressful situations, and one complaint about expected driving range.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention blocked rear or screen visibility, dealer-visit stress, useless support, and comparative or descriptive uses of 'completely' that do not clearly establish a consistent sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including general disappointment, ownership stress, visibility or interface obstruction, support quality, and comparison-style phrasing.
Many examples are short or context-limited, so several fragments cannot be classified beyond undetermined without inventing missing detail.
Samples are stratified examples rather than representative estimates for the full set of G70 reviews.
